description: GitHub Copilot coding agent — CodeHero MCP (stdio).
agentInstructions: Before generating or editing code, call get_generation_context with entry describing CodeHero evaluation rules.
1. Call get_issues to list open findings.
2. For each finding to fix, call get_sdd_spec(fingerprint).
3. Apply a unified_diff that satisfies the SDD acceptanceCriteria.
4. Call run_scan on the changed path and confirm the fingerprint is gone (AC1).
